messages:
priya_releases: Quick heads-up — starting a controlled canary for the inference-router config at 18:00 UTC (5% traffic). Link to runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/deploy-backout. Please review backout checkpoints and confirm pins.

sam_platform: Canary target: inference-router-service. Pins: model-service @ v3.2.1, runtime image inference-runtime:2026-03. Autoscaler unchanged. Config diff: small traffic-split only.

alex_dev: Which endpoints are affected? Is embeddings pipeline touched?

sam_platform: Only /v1/generate routing change for hosted-api -> new route. Embeddings unaffected.

jamie_oncall: Backout triggers we agreed: error_rate >= 1.5% p95_errors over 5m OR p95 latency > 500ms sustained for 5m OR spike in L7 5xxs > 0.5% above baseline. If hit, pause rollout and rollback to previous pin.

priya_releases: Runbook checklist excerpt:
- Preflight: smoke tests on canary pods (curl /health, sample gen)
- SLO guard: monitor p50/p95/p99 latency + error ratio
- Escape hatch: /rollout pause + pin rollback
- Postback: notify #incidents if rollback

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary started: inference-router-service @ canary=5% by sam_platform at 18:01 UTC. CI smoke passed.

morgan_sre: Add a note — the KV cache warms slowly after restart, expect small latency blips for first 1000 requests. Keep eye on cache-warm metric.

alex_dev: If we need to pin back, what's the exact command to revert the model pin? Need a one-liner for runbook.

priya_releases: Use this in console:
```
redwoodctl pin service inference-router --model v3.2.0 --runtime inference-runtime:2026-02
redwoodctl rollout rollback inference-router --to=v3.2.0
```
And then run smoke: `curl -sS https://canary-redwood/health | jq .status`

jamie_oncall: Also add: if rollback triggers, set change window note and attach correlation IDs of failed requests before archiving metric graphs.

sam_platform: Confirming: pinned backup version is v3.2.0, rollback tested in staging earlier today. I'll be standing by during traffic ramp.

priya_releases: OK. If no red flags at 18:10 we'll ramp to 25% at 18:15. I'll post status updates here. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary at 5% running. Next ramp scheduled: +20% at 18:15 UTC.

morgan_sre: I'll watch p95 and cache-warm. @jamie_oncall on-call.

alex_dev: ack

priya_releases: status: smoke ok @ 18:05, no errors in first 3 minutes. proceeding per schedule. Anyone see anything unexpected ping me.
